title: 12# Musa & Firaun 3
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ لِمُلْكُ مِصَر وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُۥ لِيُفْسِدُواْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَءَالِهَتَكَ ۚ

قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَٰهِرُونَ۝

أُوذِينَا مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا قَالُوا أُوذِينَا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِن بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا ۚ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ۝

قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِينُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاصْبِرُوا ۖ إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ۖ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ۝

نَقْصٍ مِّنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ Musa(موسى) made Dua(دُعَا) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

فَاِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوفَانَ وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّجْزُ قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَى ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ ۖ

لَئِن كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا ٱلرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ۝

وَالْجَرَادَ فَاِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ۝

وَقَالُوا مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ آيَةٍ لِّتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَإِن يَرَوْا كُلَّ آيَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَا فَاِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ۝

فَاِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ۝

وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ وَهَٰذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِي ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ۝

أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ۝

وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ۝

إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍۢ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ ۚ

وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ۝

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوٓاْ إِن كُنتُم مُّسْلِمِينَ۝

فَقَالُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ۝

رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ۝

لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ۝

وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَن تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَٱجْعَلُواْ بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۗ

وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۗ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ آتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا عَن سَبِيلِكَ ۖ

رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا عَن سَبِيلِكَ ۖ رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَىٰ أَمْوَالِهِمْ اطْمِسْ عَلَىٰ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ۝

فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ۝

And Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا Musa(موسى).

قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ۝

وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ۝

أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ۝

وَأَوْحَيْنَا أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ۝

إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ۝

وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ۝

وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ۝

إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ۝

وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ۝

وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ۝

شِرْذِمَةٌ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ۝

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ۝

وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ۝

كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ۝

فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ۝

فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ۝

كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ۝

كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ۝

إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ۝

Test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told him; وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ

إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ۝

أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَى۝

وَمَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرِي ءَامَنتُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَتْ بِهِۦ بَنُوٓاْ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ۝

تَعرَّفْ إلى اللهِ في الرَّخاء يَعْرِفْك في الشِّدَّةِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; آلْآنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ۝

اَلْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ آيَةً ۚ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ۝

لَا إلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّه and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ

وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ۝

قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّة اِبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّة وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ

وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ۝

كَمَلَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ كَثِيرٌ ولم يَكْمُلْ من النساءِ إلااَربَعَة and Asiyah Imra'atu Firaun(آسيه اِمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ) فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ
english:
The Lives Of The Prophets Part 2 Now, things were getting a little bit difficult on Firaun(فرعون).

Because this embarrassing event happened in front of all of the people of Egypt.

So, the evil advisors of Firaun(فرعون) came to him and said; You need to do something; You can't let things get out of control.

And these are the parasites living under Firaun(فرعون) who are benefiting from the situation; benefiting from the status quo.

Because these oppressive leaders, they don't exist in a vacuum.

Az-Zalamah(اظلمه); the oppressors; these kings; they don't live in a vacuum; They have an underlying power under them.

They have Chiefs; Al-Mala(اَلمَلاَ); They have advisors; They have a government; They have people who are serving them and helping them; Otherwise, they can't exist alone.

And Firaun(فرعون); even though he claimed to be God and he claimed to be the owner of Egypt.

Nevertheless, he still had to depend on these people under him.

And these are parasites who are benefiting financially and benefiting from the positions, they are getting under the leadership of Firaun(فرعون).

So, they are looking for their benefit also.

The chiefs of Firaun's people said; Will you leave Musa(موسى) and his people to spread mischief in the land?

And to abandon you and your gods or going to let this happen or going to let this go?

So, they pushed Firaun(فرعون); So he said; He said; We will kill their sons and we will let their women live and we have irresistible power over them.

Didn't Firaun(فرعون) issue this order before?

When did he issue it?

When Musa(موسى) was born.

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); When this issue was decreed; Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); What did they say?

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); they said; We have received harm when you were born and we're receiving harm from you now.

All this trouble is because of you.

They were killing us in the beginning because of you, because of your birth.

That is why our children were killed.

And now our children are killed again; Why?

Because of you another time.

And this is the nature of the people who are not willing to sacrifice anything for the sake of Allah.

People are already humiliated; They're crushed.

And they don't want to move ahead; And they're not willing to give anything.

They want victory; They want success; They want position; But they're not willing to pay the price for it.

And unfortunately, sometimes; we're guilty of doing the same thing.

How come Islam is not established?

How come there is no Khilafah(خِلَافَه)? How come?

And this person, you find him; he's not doing anything and he's blaming the whole Ummah(امة).

And he's the only one who's innocent.

Look at the Muslims! Look at the Muslims! And he's speaking about everyone; but himself.

Why is the problem in Chechnya happening?

Why is the problem in Iraq(عراق) happening?

Why is the problem in Falastine(فلسطين) happening?

Why is it happening in Kashmir(كشمير)?

It is because of the faults of me and you.

Don't think that the problem of Kashmir(كشمير) is a Kashmiri(كشميرى) problem, or the problem of the Chechens is a Chechnyan's problem, or the problem of Falastine(فلسطين) is a Falastini(فلسطينى) problem.

This is a problem of the Muslim Ummah(امة).

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى does not know these different states and nations.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى knows one Ummah(امة); one Ummah(امة).

So, whenever there's a punishment or there's a problem or there's a suffering in one part of the Ummah(امة).

It is the suffering for all of us.

And we are all held responsible for it.

So the problems we are going through now are because of us; And we are responsible for solving them.

They said; We had suffered troubles before you came to us and since you've came to us.

But Musa(موسى) told them; It may be that Your Lord will destroy your enemy and make you successors on Earth so that He may see how you act.

Allah will give you a victory over your enemy.

And Allah will give you Khilafah(خِلَافَه). But you have to go through the sacrifice.

That's the natural path to achieve victory.

And then Musa(موسى) told his people in the Ayah(آية) before; He said; Seek help from Allah and be patient.

We have to be patient; Verily, the Earth is Allah's; He gives it as a heritage to whom He wills of His slave and blessed in the end for Al-Muttaqin(المتقين).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى sent to Musa(موسى) Ayaat(آيات); signs.

How many signs do we already know of up till this moment?

Two; Which are the stick and the hand.

The Ayaat(آيات) in total were nine.

And indeed We punish the people of Pharoah with years of drought and shortness of fruits that they may remember.

So these are another two, which are; the drought and they don't have any fruits.

So now, we have four and then we have another five mentioned in another Ayah(آية).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is sending them Ayaat(آيات) and Allah says; Whenever We send them a sign, We send them a following sign which is greater than the one before it.

So, Allah is sending them powerful signs.

Why? For them to remember.

The stick was not enough; The hand was not enough.

So Allah sent on them drought.

Drought; they would get no rain.

And; They would have less fruits.

Al-Hassan(الحسن) says; these two signs are one.

And he would replace another one with Al-bahr(البحر); he would count the splitting of the sea as one sign.

So then we have five left.

Okay now, when these two signs occurred; Firaun(فرعون) and his people came to Musa(موسى) and they told him; Can you please ask your Lord to release us from this drought and from this problem?

So they sent him a delegation from the government to meet with Musa(موسى) and tell him; Please! Release us from this problem.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى provided them with rain and fruits again.

They broke their promise to Musa(موسى).

The next sign was the flood.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made the Nile River flood.

So, it would flood on the banks; it would cover their fields and then the water would stick there.

So they cannot plant in the fields.

Then, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى revealed his order; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; And then, we revealed to Musa(موسى) hit the sea with your stick.

Musa(موسى) hit the sea with the stick.

The sea split up and every portion was like a huge mountain.

Musa(موسى) in front of his eyes, is seeing this water spin up and break into two pieces and then stand up like two huge mountains in front of his eyes and in front of the eyes of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

They're seeing another Ayah(آية); In front of their eyes.

And then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Yabasan(يَبَسًا); in another Ayah(آية) in Surat-Taha(سورة طه) The bottom, the basin of the sea is wet, it's wet, there's water in it and it's mud.

How can they walk on it?

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made it dry.

Not only did it split; did the ocean, sea split, but also the basin became dry.

It is said that, some wind came and took all of the moisture away from it.

So it was firm; Yabasan(يَبَسًا).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Dry; prepared for Musa(موسى) and Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

Musa(موسى) stood and he made all of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) pass through.

And then, he was the last one to go.

When they reached to the other side, Musa(موسى), he hit the sea with his stick; because he wanted to close it.

He hit the sea with his stick.

What divided the sea?

The stick.

But, is it really the stick, that divided the sea?

It is Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, it's not stick.

If you take a stick and hit it with the water; what will happen?

You'll splash water; you will just wet your clothes.

It is not the stick that divided the sea; it is the will of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى that divided the sea.

So why did Musa(موسى) have to use the stick?

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will not give you victory until you do your part.

And if the most you could do is; hit the water with your stick, then do it.

The victory of Allah will not come until you do your part.

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wants Musa(موسى) to do his part.

And we are complaining that, the victory is not here and the reason is; because we're not doing our part.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is gonna perform miracles and is gonna give His victory to the ones who He loves; to the Awliya(اولياء) of Allah, but they need to do their part.

Rasool Allah ﷺ in the Battle of Badr(بدر).

He put the believers in ranks, he fixed them together, he did everything that is humanly possible and then, what did he do?

He went on a hill and he started making Dua(دُعَا).

He did everything that he can do.

And now, it's time to ask help from Allah.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى sent down 2000 angels to fight with them.

They had to go out, and they had to take all preparations possible, everything humanly possible and then, when they fulfill that; then they make Tawaqqul(توكل) in Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and Allah will give the victory.

So Allah wants Musa(موسى) to do his part.

The best he can do is; hit the water with a stick.

Now, Musa(موسى) on the other side, thinks that the stick can close it again.

So he is hitting the water with his stick; and he's splashing water but it's not moving.

Leave the sea alone.

Allah told Musa(موسى), Leave the sea alone.

Why?

Why did Musa(موسى) want to close the sea?

To prevent Firaun(فرعون) from coming.

He's planning, Musa(موسى) is planning.

Leave the sea alone.

Why?

Because they are going to drown.

After all of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) passed, and Musa(موسى) passed.

Firaun(فرعون) and his army, they went through the basin.

All of them; and when all of the army of Firaun(فرعون); when all of them was on the basin of the sea; all of them; from Firaun(فرعون) to the last soldier;

then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told the water to return to its natural state of water again.

And it closed on Firaun(فرعون) and his army, because the state of water change for temporary moment.

Water is water.

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made it change for a while.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gave it different qualities and then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told the water to return to its natural state of being water again.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى destroyed Firaun(فرعون) with one of his soldiers, and that's an interesting soldier.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى destroyed Firaun(فرعون) with the source of life.

Water which is the source of life, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى can use it as a soldier.

So, it destroyed Firaun(فرعون).

And it is says in the Tafseer(تفسير) that; the body of Firaun(فرعون) was spinning up and down in the water, in front of the eyes of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل)

so that, they can see the fate of the enemy of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى the tyrant Firaun(فرعون).

Firaun(فرعون) who said; I am your highest Lord.

I don't know that you have any other god, but me, was drowning in front of their eyes.

And now, the fulfillment of the Dua(دُعَا) of Musa(موسى); When Firaun(فرعون) saw the punishment of Allah, Firaun(فرعون) raised up his finger and he said;

I believe; that there is no god; but the God of the children of Israel(اسرائيل) and I'm a Muslim.

He believed in Islam.

But he believed when it was too late.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Remember Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in moments of ease, Allah will remember you in moments of difficulty.

Firaun(فرعون) did not remember Allah in moments of ease, he had wealth, he did not remember Allah, he had health, he did not remember Allah,

he had life, he did not remember Allah, he had power, he did not remember Allah, he had youth, he did not remember Allah.

But now, when he's facing death, when he was seeing the angels of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى descending on him.

He said; I believe.

Now, you want to believe when you have committed corruption before; when you have disbelief before and you have committed corruption.

We will save your body and preserver today, so that you could be assigned for the people be after you.

Most of the people are unaware of our signs.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Your Tobah(توبة) is not accepted.

When the soul is already coming out and you see the angels in front of your eyes, it's too late.

Jibreel عليه السلام came to Muhammadﷺ and said; If you have just seen me, when Firaun(فرعون) was drowning, and I was stuffing his mouth with mud.

So that the mercy of Allah would not come on him.

Look at, how much not only Musa(موسى) hated Firaun(فرعون); even Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل); Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) said that, he was stuffing dirt in the mouth of Firaun(فرعون).

When he saw that, he wants to say; He started stuffing that dirt in his mouth; so that, the mercy would not come on this man.

You can see that, this man was unbelievable.

He was a tyrant and for Musa(موسى) to make such a Dua(دُعَا) against him and to say; Oh Allah! Don't guide him.

And for Jibreel عليه السلام, the angel who would come with Al-Wahi(الوحى) from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) is stuffing the dirt in his mouth so that he cannot speak.

That is how bad the tyranny of Firaun(فرعون) was.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى destroyed Firaun(فرعون) Today we will preserve your body.

Why?

So that you can be assigned for the people after you.

The body of Firaun(فرعون) is being carried from one place to another around the world; mummified.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has saved that body.

And one of the researchers said; they made some research on the body of Firaun(فرعون); they found a very high concentration of salt in it.

He drowned in salt water.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said that, We preserve the body of Firaun(فرعون); not to show you the glory of the Firaunic civilization, not for you to put him in a museum and you go and visit to see the magnificent heritage of Firaun(فرعون),

not to go and take pictures of the body of Firaun(فرعون) to show how great that civilization was.

Firaun(فرعون) who was the worst; whom Allahسُبحانه وتعالى kept his body so that it would be a sign for us.

The people are treating his body and his existence, the exact opposite way of how it was intended.

And that's why Allahسُبحانه وتعالى closes this Ayah(آية) with; But most of the people are unaware of our signs.

People in the world today are unaware of the sign of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Firaun(فرعون) was left behind to be a reminder for us, what will happen to Al-Kafirin(الكافرين).

This is the end result; that is, what will happen to them.

There's something that I want to mention about Musa(موسى) and Firaun(فرعون).

From the people of Firaun(فرعون); very few followed the Da'wah(دعوة) of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

One of them was Momin-Al-Firaun(مومن ال فرعون); and his story is mentioned in Qur'an and it's a long story.

And his story In sha Allah(ان شاالله) we could talk about it in a separate series about Al-Qass-Al-Qur'an(القص القرآن); The stories of Qur'an.

And then, there's also Asiyah Imra'atu Firaun(آسيه اِمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ); who believed.

Asiyah(آسيه); the wife of Firaun(فرعون).

She believed in Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and the message of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

And Asiyah(آسيه) is the one who raised up; Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى); so for him; she was like a second mother.

And Asiyah(آسيه); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى talked about her in Qur'an and Rasool Allah ﷺ also mentioned her in few Ahadith(احاديث).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى talks about the wife of Firaun(فرعون).

And she made a Dua(دُعَا) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

It's an interesting Dua(دُعَا). She said; Oh Allah! Built for me a house in Jannah(جنة).

You might be amazed; why did she specifically asked for house in Jannah(جنة)?

Why specifically a house?

If you would look at her situation, that she would lived in; then you would understand; why she's asking for a house?

She was living in the palace of Firaun(فرعون).

She's the queen.

She has everything, a woman seeking Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) would ask for.

She has everything that Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) can offer.

But the thing that was missing; there was Islam and Eeman(ايمان).

She was living in that place like an alien or a stranger, who doesn't belong there.

She's saying; Oh Allah!

Oh Allah! Built for me a house in Jannah(جنة).

I'm not gonna live in it now, But one day, In Sha Allahu Ta'ala(إنْ شاءالله تعالى), I'll be able to be there.

So, prepare it for me, Build it for me.

And then she said, when she said; Build for me a house in Jannah(جنة), she said; And save me from Firaun(فرعون) and his deeds.

So built for me a house in Jannah(جنة) and then take me out of this environment.

Take me out of this place.

She has gold, she has silver, she has the servents, she's the queen over Egypt, but she's saying; Oh Allah! Take me out of that environment;

take me out; I don't wanna be there.

Take me away from these oppressive people.

That is why, Asiyah(آسيه) qualified to be one of the four women, whom Rasool Allah ﷺ praise in Hadith(حديث).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The men who were complete were many.

But the women, who are complete are only four.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; These four were; Maryam Bint-e-Imran(مريم بنت عمران) and Khadijah(خديجه) and Fatima(فاطمه).

And we find that these four women are relating in some way or another to Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

Two of them raised up Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) and one of them was the wife of a Nabi(نَبِي) and the other one was a daughter of a Nabi(نَبِي).

Maryam(مريم) and Asiyah(آسيه) raised up Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

Maryam(مريم) raised up Eesa(عيسى) and Asiyah(آسيه) raised up Musa(موسى) and Khadijah(خديجه) has a wife of a Nabi(نَبِي) and Fatima Bint-e-Muhammad(فاطمه بنت محمد) is the daughter of the leader of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); Muhammadﷺ.

These are the only four complete women.

Asiyah(آسيه) believed in the message of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى), so did Momin-Al-Firaun(مومن ال فرعون), and then the rest, if we would take the Tafseer(تفسير) of;

That would mean some children from the people of Firaun(فرعون) and there's also Mashitut-Al-Firaun(ماشتت ال فرعون); there's one woman who used to comb for the daughters.

But to sum it up; there are only a few who believe.

This is the end of the story of Musa(موسى) and Firaun(فرعون).

Now, we'll start with a new chapter and that is The story of Musa(موسى) and Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).
